linker_script.notes: This retained 571-byte source adds aligned NOLOAD .noinit after stack. Framework default link.ld differs (494 bytes); preserve retained source for same arena layout.

timing_header.notes: Source text directly retained; rd_mcycle volatile csrr with memory clobber. It does not itself drain accelerator; completion belongs in invocation.

startup.mstatus: FS=Initial bit13 and VS=Initial bit9; VS bit is WARL on no-vector core; no vector instructions in startup
startup.rounding: fcsr=0 when compiled FP ISA => round-nearest ties-even and exception flags cleared
startup.bss: hart0 clears [_bss_start,_bss_end) then fence and sets boot_ready; each hart waits then main(mhartid)
startup.uninitialized_arena: NOLOAD .noinit intentionally not cleared; caller initializes every input and poisons outputs

console.type: HTIF syscall-proxy through host fesvr/FireSim TSI; no target UART MMIO
console.addressing: Host finds tohost/fromhost by ELF symbol names in .htif, not one hard-coded MMIO address. Linker places .htif at next4KiB after text. Retain symbol table and record each final linked address.
console.console_init: Resets buffer length; no MMIO bringup
console.protocol: Static8192-byte buffer; static8-byte-aligned4xuint64 request [64,1,buffer_address,length]. Fence rw,rw then tohost=request_address; spin until fromhost!=0; clear fromhost; fence. Default newline flush enabled.
console.exit: Flush output then tohost=(uint32(code)<<1)|1 and spin; code0 produces tohost1 success.
console.reentrancy: HTIF buffered state is not interrupt/reentrant safe; do not print from timed kernel or interrupt concurrently.

traps.policy: Fail fast; no illegal-instruction emulation or skipping
traps.limitation: Handler calls C console and assumes stack already valid, as comment documents; faults in first startup instructions before stack setup may lack full diagnostic.
